SELECT s.physical_subsystem_id AS id,COALESCE(NULLIF(p.short_name,''),REPLACE(p.name,'物理子系统','')) AS name,p.code FROM tm_test_participating_system s JOIN arch_physical_subsystem p ON p.id=s.physical_subsystem_id AND p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0 WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.test_domain=#{domain} AND s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.enabled=1 AND s.deleted=0 ORDER BY name,p.id

SELECT id,round_name,planned_start_date,planned_end_date,status FROM tm_test_round WHERE ORDER BY sort_no,id

SELECT c.id,c.round_id,c.cycle_name,c.planned_start_date,c.planned_end_date,c.status FROM tm_test_cycle c JOIN tm_test_round r ON r.id=c.round_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.deleted=0 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.test_domain=#{domain} AND r.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.sort_no,c.id

SELECT r.id,r.report_name,r.report_type,r.scope_type,r.round_id,r.cycle_id,r.physical_subsystem_id,r.special_node_id,r.current_version_no,CONCAT('V',r.current_version_no) AS current_version,r.generated_at,u.display_name AS generator_name,rr.round_name,c.cycle_name,COALESCE(NULLIF(s.short_name,''),REPLACE(s.name,'物理子系统','')) AS physical_system_name,n.node_name AS special_name FROM tm_test_report r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=r.generated_by AND u.tenant_id=r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tm_test_round rr ON rr.id=r.round_id LEFT JOIN tm_test_cycle c ON c.id=r.cycle_id LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem s ON s.id=r.physical_subsystem_id LEFT JOIN tm_test_plan_special_node n ON n.id=r.special_node_id AND n.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE ORDER BY r.generated_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_report WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND scope_type=#{scope} AND physical_subsystem_id <=> #{systemId} AND special_node_id <=> #{specialNodeId} AND report_name=#{name}
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_report SET report_name=#{name},report_type=#{type},round_id=#{roundId},cycle_id=#{cycleId},source_type=#{source},selected_sections=#{sectionsJson},updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0)+1 FROM tm_test_report_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND report_id=#{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_report SET current_version_no=#{versionNo},generated_by=#{userId},generated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{reportId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,version_no,generated_by,generated_at FROM tm_test_report_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND report_id=#{reportId} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT r.*,COALESCE(NULLIF(s.short_name,''),REPLACE(s.name,'物理子系统','')) AS physical_system_name FROM tm_test_report r LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem s ON s.id=r.physical_subsystem_id WHERE r.id=#{reportId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.test_domain=#{domain} AND r.project_id=#{projectId}
SELECT id,version_no,snapshot_json,generated_by,generated_at FROM tm_test_report_version WHERE id=#{versionId} AND report_id=#{reportId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT chapter_code,content_html,updated_at,(SELECT display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=s.updated_by AND u.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0) AS updater_name FROM tm_test_report_supplement s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.report_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY chapter_code

SELECT id,version_no,generated_at,(SELECT display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=v.generated_by AND u.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0) AS generator_name FROM tm_test_report_version v WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND report_id=#{reportId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_report_supplement WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND report_version_id=#{versionId} AND chapter_code=#{chapter}
